 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 18.6 4 Blair Tickner to Nitish Reddy, FOUR , slower-ball on a short of length and width outside off, Nitish Kumar Reddy reaches for it to slash and the thick top-edge flies over Tim Seifert. Runs away to the third man fence 18.5 Blair Tickner to Bhuvneshwar Kumar, 1 run, short of length outside off, Bhuvneshwar Kumar goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man 18.4 W Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, out Caught by Michael Bracewell!! This time it's taken. Good catch by extra-cover running back. Bracewell with two hands as he dives forward to take it. Tumbles to ground after that. Blair Tickner celebrates by taking a card out which has a fire icon on it. The knuckle-ball and full outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward to loft, the bat turns and it's sliced off a thick outer half. Good catch and Tickner is pumped. Scott Styris on air says it's the Pokemon card . Tickner kisses that. Naman Dhir c Michael Bracewell b Blair Tickner 33(23) [4s-4 6s-1] 18.3 Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, no run, slower-ball and short of length outside off, Naman Dhir slashes and misses 18.2 6 Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, SIX , just over the knee this low full-toss, on middle-stump, Naman Dhir helps it away. The fat top-edge flying over fine-leg and some 15 rows back. Naman was flicking that and used the pace of Blair Tickner to great effect 18.1 Blair Tickner to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, slower-ball and full outside off, Nitish Kumar Reddy gets forward to loft, right off the bottom of the bat and Mitchell does well to stop that as it bounces in front of him at long-on. He went for the catch and got his body behind it. Was the knuckle-ball 15.6 Blair Tickner to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, full and the slower-ball on off, Nitish Kumar Reddy gets forward to heave and it's off the thick inner half, and straight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket 15.5 Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, full and seam-up, around off, Naman Dhir gets forward and shows the full face of the bat to drive it hard and straight to long-off 15.4 4 Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, FOUR , and the next ball goes for four. It's a slower-ball and full outside off, Naman Dhir again shows his wrists. Generates enough power to drill the drive to the left of extra-cover, who dives and can't stop it. No chance for sweeper cover to his right 15.3 Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, no run, dropped by Milne at sweeper cover. 15th drop by New Zealand this series says Simon Doull on air. It's a slower-ball and short of length outside off, Naman Dhir slashes and there's no timing at all. Straight in and straight out. Easy as it went straight to him. Doull feels Milne was too casual there 15.2 Blair Tickner to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, a grunt from Blair Tickner as he delivered that. On a short of length on middle, angled in, Nitish Kumar Reddy pushes it to long-on 15.1 Blair Tickner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, slower-ball on a good length outside off, Naman Dhir punches square of the wicket on the off-side. Finds deep point 10.6 Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, length and the slower-ball outside off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to punch to sweeper cover and retains the strike with that run 10.5 Blair Tickner to Tilak Varma, 1 run, short outside off, Tilak Varma goes on the back foot to pull, doesn't time it but it rolls away to the vacant forward short-leg area 10.4 Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, full on off, bit of angle in, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to flick to deep square leg 10.3 Blair Tickner to Tilak Varma, 1 run, length delivery just outside off, Tilak Varma drops and runs wide of backward point and is off the mark 10.2 W Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, out Caught by Nathan Smith!! Straight to deep mid-wicket. Some respite for Blair Tickner after dropping Shreyas Iyer. Length delivery outside off, Ishan Kishan looks to heave and doesn't connect properly. Straight to deep mid-wicket and Nathan Smith makes no mistake. Tickner roars in delight as he punches the air. End of a fine knock and New Zealand needed that wicket. Was the wobble-seam delivery. Ishan Kishan c Nathan Smith b Blair Tickner 61(32) [4s-5 6s-5] 10.1 Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, slower-ball on a good length on off, Shreyas Iyer turns it to the vacant mid-wicket area. The call is for two but Blair Tickner runs and keeps it to one 5.6 Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, no run, length delivery and tight on off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward and defends it back. That was a good delivery and Shreyas shows it respect 5.5 Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short of length outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and cuts straight to the fielder at deep point 5.4 4 Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, FOUR , too straight and swung away wide of short fine to his right. Length delivery on off, Ishan Kishan uses the angle and whips it away 5.3 Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, back of a length and on the body, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and nudges it to the backward square leg area 5.2 Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short of length and following Ishan Kishan outside leg, he lifts one leg up in the air, pulls to deep backward square-leg. Just one as it's straight to the fielder 5.1 6 Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, SIX , Blair Tickner is welcomed with a six.
